title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Default six-keyword rotation against myprocom-portal.procomservices.com. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: First run, September 19, 2026 — no eligible target-family postings; inventory currently skews heavily toward Salesforce, AI/ML, embedded, and data-center hardware roles.

notes_sections.heading: Geographic and rate exclusion
items: Senior Systems Engineer (Cloud & Infrastructure) (Toronto, ON, hybrid, $53–$70/hr CAD, posted July 10, 2026 — the only genuinely target-family title found this run): excluded on three grounds at once — Toronto is outside the reachable-city range, $53–70/hr is well below the $100/hr full-time-consulting-contract floor, and a July 10 post date (over two months old against a September 19 run) makes it likely stale/expired even before the other two gates apply.

notes_sections.heading: Pipeline match — not rescored/refiled
items: Senior Salesforce DevOps Engineer – AI Automation (client: AI Automation — Flextrack): appeared in 3 of the 4 keyword searches that returned results (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer). Already New in applications.md (found 2026-08-25, score 6, Procom). Not refiled.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions
items: The remaining 17 unique postings had no SRE/Platform/DevOps center of gravity: QA Automation Engineer, Senior Salesforce Integration Engineer, Senior AI Engineer, Embedded C++ Software Engineer (Android Automotive/AOSP), Senior Embedded Software Engineer - Automotive, Network Engineer, Programmer Analyst - Senior, AI Engineer / Solution Lead, Junior Analytics Engineer, Principal Data Architect, Infrastructure Early Life Support (Desktop Engineer — end-user support, not infrastructure platform work), Commissioning Engineer-Data Centers, Data Center Field Service Engineer (Transformer-Specific) (both hardware/facilities roles, not IT infrastructure), Senior Python/SQL Engineer - Risk Division, Unified Communication Voice Specialist III, Senior Project/Solutions Engineer, Lead Machine Learning Engineer.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: DevSecOps Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer both returned zero results outright ("We're unable to find any jobs matching your search").

Browser-driven throughout, per the skill's requirement — the public marketing site dead-ends, but the real contractor portal (myprocom-portal.procomservices.com) loaded cleanly with no login needed. Used the find tool to enumerate all result cards per search, since a naive text extraction only surfaces the first visible card.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
